hypotheses.hypothesis: All observed graphic variation is merely faithful copying of one unchanged complete mold/template.
hypotheses.prediction: Full readable signs on the same template must have the same stroke group.
hypotheses.test: Selected same-main triad contains primary-reviewed2,3,4 long-stroke groups; exact-pair dedup retains all three.
hypotheses.status: Contradicted for one unchanged faithful complete template, conditional on correct source readings.
surviving_variants: Damage or transcription errors requiring independent evidence
hypotheses.limitation: Exact mold identity of these objects is unknown; this does not reject manufacture as a source of statistical dependence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stroke group is a non-amount production-lot label, constant within independently defined lot.
hypotheses.prediction: Blinded composition/tooling/production-context lot membership predicts count category in withheld objects.
hypotheses.falsifier: Different clear categories within one independently defined constant-label lot.
hypotheses.anti_circularity: Do not define lot by count or assign each discrepant object a new lot after seeing results.
hypotheses.not_exclusive_of_quantity: Quantity tokens may also be produced by denomination-specific lots.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two/three/four groups are stylistic variants conditioned on engraver, mold family or available space.
hypotheses.prediction: Independent microscopic style or available-space measurements predict variants on withheld objects under a fixed mapping.
hypotheses.falsifier: Failure of the locked predictor, including distinct forms within a group where model predicts one, rejects that restricted model.
hypotheses.status: Not established; normalized drawings are inadequate for microstyle or width analysis.
hypotheses.comparative_evidence: 2000 paper reports same inscriptions copied by at least3engravers, so same inscription is not one engraver. This does not prove or refute the exact triad allographic hypothesis.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Auxiliary state labels an independently defined class rather than a quantity.
hypotheses.prediction: Predefined material/shape/context categories predict auxiliary state across new objects and main strings.
hypotheses.tested_restriction: State determined by exact main, coarse objecttype3, side layout and original directions alone.
hypotheses.status: Tested restriction contradicted by4548/4509/4508; finer classes remain untested.
hypotheses.falsifier: Different states within an independently defined class if model promises one fixed state.
hypotheses.anti_circularity: Arbitrary A/B/C renaming has no independent test and is not positive evidence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Graphic form changes in specified production intervals.
hypotheses.prediction: Predetermined independent chronological bins predict ordered replacement across multiple main strings.
hypotheses.falsifier: All forms in a securely contemporary primary production assemblage contradict a strict single-form-per-interval rule.
hypotheses.status: Untested; no narrow production dates for exact triad.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Auxiliary group is an issue/validity-period category rather than represented amount.
hypotheses.prediction: Independently known issue episodes predict field categories under a frozen mapping.
hypotheses.status: No decoded date or independent issue mapping; paper discussion of expiry is tentative motivation only.
hypotheses.falsifier: Verified issue episodes conflicting with fixed proposed categories; model must specify handling of reuse before test.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Count differences result solely from damage, incomplete impressions or copying error.
hypotheses.prediction: Original photographs/microscopy reveal missing/added/recut strokes and support one underlying form.
hypotheses.status: No loss/doubt marked in strongest triad drawings; original-object verification still needed.
hypotheses.falsifier: Clearly complete undamaged differing groups undermine a damage-only account.

conclusion: Replication is a real dependence mechanism but does not alone remove the primary graphic variation. A separately varying non-amount category associated with production/use remains viable but unverified. No quantity, date, category or phonetic interpretation wins from this pilot alone.
